trend_only: No countertrend branch. bias4h == side is a hard requirement for every entry, with no "strong reversal" exception. A prior revision (S7vp) had such an exception and did not survive holdout; it is removed here, not tuned.
selection: At least 40 validation trades across four pairs. Prefer positive portfolio in both splits, then validation return minus half EOD DD. Freeze one global configuration before unused evaluation.
disclosure: December-March and August periods were used by earlier S7 revisions (indicator-confluence and countertrend variants). April-July 2026 has not been used to pick parameters for any S7 variant and is held aside as holdout. This is a retrospective screen, not real-time forward trading.
scenarios: 20x development; frozen holdout at 20x and 30x, with 2 and 5 bps slippage.
limit_model: Must be non-marketable at placement, penetrate 2 bps, expire after 30 minutes. No same-fill-minute profit target. No queue model.
liquidation: Conservative deposit-vs-stop buffer only; no historical mark-price liquidation simulation.
stopping_rule: If no variant reaches profit_factor > 1 after costs on holdout for at least 3 of 4 pairs, this closes the indicator/price-action S7 scalping research direction. No further variant search follows a negative holdout.
